diag-wa-run-help.stdout:
Usage: wa run [options] <prompt>

Run a new task (alias for wa task run)

Arguments:
  prompt                    Task prompt or description

Options:
  --computer <id>           Target specific computer
  --model <name>            Use specific model
  --runtime <name>          Use specific runtime
  --agent <name>            Use specific agent
  --force                   Run even if the agent failed its last preflight
                            check
  --max-turns <number>      Maximum turns per task
  --type <type>             Task type: chat, coding, research, etc.
  --preset <name>           Runtime preset (e.g. standard, minimal)
  --expected-files <files>  Expected changed files (comma-separated)
  --allow-hosted            Allow routing to an authenticated hosted provider
                            (NVIDIA, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google)
  --routing-mode <mode>     Routing policy mode: AUTO, NVIDIA, LOCAL_ONLY,
                            HYBRID
  --json                    Output in JSON format
  -h, --help                display help for command

diag-wa-chat-help.stdout:
Usage: wa chat [options]

Open the conversation-first coding assistant

Options:
  --dashboard             Open the full-screen fleet dashboard
  --legacy                Use the legacy full-screen fleet dashboard
  --concurrency <number>  Concurrent agent limit across the fleet (default: 4)
  --no-worktrees          Disable git worktree isolation
  --auto-merge            Automatically merge completed agent branches into
                          main
  --timeout <seconds>     Stop a job automatically after this many seconds
                          (default: no limit)
  --planner               Enable 3-layer Planner-Supervisor-Executor
                          architecture (pre-execution DAG planning)
  -h, --help              display help for command
